attempts.rationale: Use ranking instability and strong trend/seasonality – a robust weighted combo should help.
Test a robust non‑weighted median combination to see if a simple robust aggregator beats the weighted inverse‑error combo.
test a robust DBA combination to see if iterative refinement beats weighted inverse-error in this unstable ranking scenario.
Test a trimmed‑mean combination to see if trimming extreme correlated errors improves robustness in this unstable ranking, seasonal‑trend series.
test a simple mean of all models to see if a non‑robust aggregator can beat the trimmed mean in this mixed trend/seasonal series with unstable ranking.
test a per‑model softmax weighting to see if a softer emphasis on low‑error models improves over inverse_error, given unstable ranking and strong trend/seasonality.
The series has unstable rankings and strong seasonality; a per‑horizon best‑model weighting may capture horizon‑specific strengths.
ranking is unstable and several correlated groups exist; a forward‑selection weighted combo may pick a complementary pair.

decision.justification: Selected 'weighted weighted by w4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 11 backtested attempts, score 0.9919. Series context: trend strength 1.0 and seasonal strength 1.0; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.021); 1 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.566.
